inputs.profile:
# Audio Profile
A warm, softly spoken English woman of about forty-five, the voice of a television charity appeal: hushed, slow, achingly sincere, every pause leaning on your conscience. Clear, gentle received pronunciation.

## Scene:
A quiet recording booth, reading the voiceover for a monochrome charity appeal over a sad piano.

## Sample Context:
She means every word. She lets each sentence hang, as if the hardship is almost too much to say.
